notes.title: Update 6th July 2024
notes.notes:
Perfomance Update 

The latest update includes a series of optimisations, so the game should run at a higher FPS and be more stable. 

I would love to hear from anyone how it performs on other PCs..... 

Some technical stuff I should have known when I started, include:
- Removed a bunch of dynamic lights
- setup LODs
- Decreased Culling Distance
- setup HLOD
- Texture compression

notes.title: FPS Steamfest April 2024 update
notes.notes:
Demo Update
I have updated the Demo in preparation for FPS Steamfest April 2024. The Demo now includes all the game content in its current form, including the second level, the "Dungeon."

Main game update
I have started work on two more levels. I have blocked out the stages, paced the action, and am looking for an Environmental artist. I cannot estimate the full release precisely as I am not working full-time on the project.

notes.title: Update 21 October 2023
notes.notes:
Replaced all Sci-fi elements with Medieval Fantasy.

All enemies now yield medieval weapons or cast magic. I tried initially to weave a setting where sci-fi and medieval worlds collide, but I failed. So I am leaning hard all in a medieval setting, replacing all futuristic elements with medieval or fantasy.

Major Performance update

I have further optimised the current two levels to a satisfactory level. I can now focus on creating more levels.

notes.title: Update 29 April 2023
notes.notes:
Technical:
* Increased texture streaming pool. 
   RAM Minimum requirements increased to 16 GB

* Increased performance of rendering enemies. Significant performance improvement on Level 2
   Increased Minimum Required Disk Space to 12 GB

General
* I will be increased the price slightly in a month and the current build will be free as a demo

* Working on a new feature: endless run/survival mode 
   There are probably more technical issues to be fixed, but as I am a solo dev it gets really boring working only on one thing all the time, and I lose motivation to carry on.

notes.title: Update 14th April 2023
notes.notes:
Technical: 
* Anti-aliasing was not working, it is now set to TAA

Gameplay: 
* Reduced base walking speed. Sprint is optional as a passive skill
* Grenadier will telegraph attack before firing with an animation

Level 01 specific: 
* Several collision issues have been fixed. 
* Performance Optimized a bit.
